rules.rule: Production code arrives with the failing test that drove it. A source change with no test beside it is a finding.

No gate is disabled, overridden or loosened: no lint suppression comment, no lowered mutation or coverage threshold, no silenced spelling or prose rule. A gate change lands only with a decision record beside it.
Code carries no comments. The one exception is a constraint the code cannot express through naming or structure.
An expected failure is a typed result the caller reads, not a thrown surprise. An error message names the operation that failed and why.
